description: Permanently delete up to 300 Marketo named account list records (POST /rest/v1/namedAccountLists/delete.json). delete_by is dedupeFields (name, default) or idField (marketoGUID). Destructive async write: poll check_marketo_job_status for per-record deleted/skipped status and reasons.
embedding_description: Permanently delete Marketo named account lists (ABM account lists), up to 300 per batch, matched by name or marketoGUID. Destructive async write; the named accounts on the list are not deleted. Returns per-record deleted or skipped status with reasons such as record not found. Distinct from delete_named_accounts.

result_processor_customizations.action_label: Marketo named account lists delete job dispatched
result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with job_id and status 'queued'. The completed job result is Marketo's per-record results array (seq, marketoGUID or id, status, reasons), row_count and tallies (status -> count).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: This changes vendor state and is destructive: deleted records are not recoverable through the API. A queued job is not vendor success: poll check_marketo_job_status, then report the tallies and any skipped records with their reasons.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Delete Marketo named account lists on the configured instance.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: marketo.invalid_params: refused at dispatch before any vendor call (missing or malformed parameters, more than 300 entries, an action/dedupe_by/delete_by value Marketo does not define). On the finished job: marketo.permission_denied (vendor 603 or HTTP 403) means the API user's Role lacks the Access API permission; marketo.auth_failed (601/602 after one re-mint, or HTTP 401) means the credential was rejected; marketo.validation_failed and other vendor codes carry Marketo's own message. A transport fault after dispatch may follow a vendor mutation.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: marketo.permission_denied: grant Read-Write Named Account List under Admin > Users & Roles > Roles > the API role > Access API, then retry. Read the records back with get_named_account_lists before retrying a write that ended in a transport fault.
